findings.issue: No request timeout on any Supabase query — slow DB can block Node event loop indefinitely, causing complete API outage
findings.impact: 30s DB query latency blocks all request threads; entire API becomes unresponsive; no circuit breaker to give recovery time
findings.fix: Add AbortSignal.timeout(10000) to all Supabase queries; wrap Supabase client in circuit breaker

findings.issue: Socket.io has no connection state recovery — clients lose all room memberships on reconnect; no offline message queue
findings.impact: Messages sent during disconnect window are lost; after reconnect, clients must manually re-join each channel
findings.fix: Enable connectionStateRecovery; implement client-side reconnection with exponential backoff; add message queue flush on reconnect

findings.issue: No global error boundary around workspace/channel content — uncaught React errors show blank page with no recovery action
findings.impact: Any unhandled React error in chat components results in a completely blank UI; user must manually refresh
findings.fix: Add ErrorBoundary wrapper with 'Try Again' button around chat content area

findings.issue: Webhook GET route reads workspace_id from query param but middleware reads req.params — query param never checked for authorization
findings.impact: Webhook listing endpoint bypasses workspace membership validation
findings.fix: Add query parameter reading middleware or move workspace_id to route param

findings.issue: Push notification delivery failures use console.error instead of structured logger.error
findings.impact: Push failures invisible in centralized logging; no ability to alert on failure rates
findings.fix: Replace console.error with logger.error including structured context (notification type, user agent, error code)

findings.issue: Cloudflare origin cert and private key written to disk via echo heredoc in CI/CD — secret exposure risk
findings.impact: TLS private key could appear in CI logs on shell failure; compromises TLS security for production domain
findings.fix: Use GitHub Actions env file ($GITHUB_ENV) for secrets; avoid echo-based file writing

findings.issue: GDPR delete route does not clean up audit_logs or consent_logs — user's audit trail persists after account deletion
findings.impact: GDPR Right to Erasure partially implemented; user data remains in audit and consent tables
findings.fix: Add explicit deletion of audit_logs and consent_logs entries for the deleted user

findings.issue: No Redis container defined in production Docker compose — REDIS_URL is configured but no Redis service exists
findings.impact: Redis-dependent features (idempotency, socket adapter, rate limiting) silently fall back to in-memory mode
findings.fix: Add Redis service to docker-compose.prod.yml or document that Redis is an external managed service

findings.issue: In-memory idempotency fallback has no LRU eviction or max size — unbounded memory growth under high message volume
findings.impact: Potential OOM on burst traffic patterns
findings.fix: Add LRU eviction with max 10000 entries to in-memory Map

findings.issue: Audit event queue is in-memory with no persistence — events lost on process restart
findings.impact: Audit trail gaps during deploy/hotfix windows
findings.fix: Replace in-memory queue with Redis-backed persistent queue

findings.issue: No down/rollback scripts exist for any of 26 migrations — forward-fix is the only recovery path
findings.impact: Migration rollback requires PITR with data loss instead of simple SQL reversal
findings.fix: Write .down.sql scripts for all migrations; mandate down scripts for all future migrations

findings.issue: No distributed tracing — only basic request IDs; no OpenTelemetry span propagation across services
findings.impact: Cannot trace a single user action across API -> DB -> WebSocket -> webhook
findings.fix: Add OpenTelemetry for Express, Supabase queries, and outbound HTTP calls

findings.issue: Frontend has no structured logging — console.log/error used ad-hoc with no format
findings.impact: Client-side errors cannot be diagnosed from logs
findings.fix: Add frontend logging library with remote log shipping for production errors

findings.issue: Feature flag service uses getSupabaseAdmin() for ALL operations including reads — bypasses RLS
findings.impact: Overprivileged data access pattern; RLS cannot restrict feature flag reads
findings.fix: Use req.supabase for reads, getSupabaseAdmin() only for writes
